title: L1 [STOCK] · NEWSROOM · Insider sale is a number you divide · card 2026-09-25-0630/k1
x:
A Form 4 reached the SEC at 21:33 UK on Thursday. Robinhood's CEO sold every one of his Class A shares. Direct holding after the sale: zero.

That is one true headline. The other true headline is in the same filing.

On 22 Sep he converted 240,834 Class B shares to Class A and sold them at $125.33 and $126.14. About $30.2m.

He still holds 47,794,572 Class B shares. So the sale was 0.50% of his stake. Half a percent.

And the filing states the plan: a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted on 5 September 2025. A calendar set a year ago, not a decision made that week.

"Dumps entire stake" and "sold 0.5% on a schedule" are both in the one document. Only one of them is the story.

An insider sale is a number you divide, not a headline you read. Shares sold over shares kept. Then check the plan date. Two minutes with the primary source.

$HOOD is not a recommendation. This is how I read a filing, not a view on the stock and not advice.
Don't guess. Measure. Full edition, every source, on the BuyTrigger Newsroom.
